## Overview

**Valen Healoris** is a legendary elven general renowned for his ruthlessness in battle and his affinity for bloodshed. He is a traitor to the mortal races: approximately 91 years ago, he and his entire military unit defected to the monster army, trading their swords for power, survival, and a place in the hierarchy of the enemy.

He is the biological father of **Odessa Merikh**, conceived through rape during a raid on a human village. He does not know she exists.

---

## Appearance

An elf of advanced years (though elves age gracefully), Valen carries himself with the bearing of a career soldier. His hair is silver-white, his face lined with the scars of centuries of warfare. His eyes are cold and calculating — the eyes of a man who has killed without hesitation and will do so again.

He wears the armor of an elven general, now modified with trophies from his monster army allies: bones, claws, and other marks of favor from the commanders he serves. A blade at his side has drunk deeply over the decades.

---

## Background

### The Elven General

Valen rose through the ranks of the elven military during the reconquering era, earning a reputation for effectiveness and brutality in equal measure. He was the kind of commander who achieved results — and the kind who left a trail of bodies that included his own soldiers when they failed him.

### The Defection

Approximately 91 years ago, Valen made a choice that would define the rest of his life. He saw the contest between the mortal races and the monster army as a war the mortals could not win. Rather than die fighting for a lost cause, he defected — taking his entire unit with him.

The monster army, ever eager for competent mortal commanders who understood the enemy's tactics, welcomed him. He was given territory to command, minions to lead, and the freedom to exercise his sadistic tendencies without restraint.

### The Raid on the Merikh Cabin

Valen's betrayal was not the only secret he needed to bury. **Eryx Merikh**, a member of his unit, had deserted with proof of the defection — and with proof of an even darker truth: elven leadership had surrendered captives to the **Crimson Covenant** for their experiments.

But there was a third wound, the most personal of all. **Satriya** — the woman Valen loved — had chosen Eryx. She had married him, built a life with him, and raised a child with him.

When Valen finally tracked Eryx to the remote cabin, he led the strike team personally. He broke through Satriya's runic barrier, killed their protector beast, and spent hours extracting information from Eryx and Satriya before killing them. He did not know that a 13-year-old half-elf girl was hidden in the alcove, listening to every scream.

### Current Position

Valen commands a territory within monster-held lands, leading a mixed force of monster minions and his elven defector unit. He is respected by intelligent monster leadership for his tactical acumen and his willingness to do whatever is necessary. He has spent 91 years consolidating his position, and he intends to be on the winning side when the war ends.

---

## Personality

Valen is cold, calculating, and utterly without mercy. He views morality as a weakness, sentiment as a liability, and power as the only measure of worth. He is capable of great cruelty — not out of rage, but out of a calm, clinical enjoyment of suffering.

He is also intelligent. He did not defect to the monster army on a whim; he calculated the odds and chose the path that gave him the best chance of survival and advancement. He is patient, strategic, and dangerous.

---

## Abilities

- **Military Command:** Centuries of experience leading elven soldiers and, more recently, monster forces
- **Martial Prowess:** A deadly swordsman, honed through decades of warfare
- **Tactical Genius:** Excellent at reading battlefields, anticipating enemy movements, and exploiting weaknesses
- **Ruthlessness:** Willing to sacrifice anyone and anything to achieve his objectives

---

## Goals

1. Maintain his position within the monster army's hierarchy
2. Eliminate any remaining threats from his past (including any trace of Eryx's proof)
3. Survive the war on the winning side

---

## Relationship to Odessa

Valen does not know he has a daughter. The rape at the human village was, to him, a footnote — a moment of violence in a campaign of violence. He never learned that the woman he raped bore a child, and he has no reason to connect the half-elf assassin who has been hunting him to that distant act.

When he learns the truth — and he will, if Odessa's quest succeeds — it will be one of the few shocks a man like him can still feel.

---

## GM Notes

- Valen is a **mortal enemy** within the monster army, not a supernatural one. He is a reminder that the enemy is not always monstrous in appearance — sometimes it wears an elven face and speaks with a general's authority.
- His knowledge of the monster army's internal structure, leadership, and tactics makes him a valuable intelligence target for the Last Stand.
- His connection to the Crimson Covenant (through the elven surrender of captives) creates a potential link to the larger conspiracy — though Valen himself may not know the full truth.
- The revelation of Odessa's parentage should be a **major dramatic moment** — not something discovered casually.
